Download **bambu-deck-0.1.9.streamDeckPlugin** and double-click it; Stream Deck installs the plugin along with its profiles.

- Simple keys carry a small printer toolhead in the corner instead of the bamboo mark
- Website in eight languages (English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Russian, Chinese, Japanese) with a language switcher, and a new four-step walkthrough: switch the printer to LAN mode, read the serial number, enter it in Stream Deck, connect
